Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct banquet enquiry form, digital menu, aur party booking features integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/khattamitha

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Khatta Mitha, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant aur banquet hall ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct banquet inquiry options and a showcase for your family dining spaces in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menus aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
